benefits.name: Companion Certificate
benefits.description: Annual Delta Main Cabin round-trip companion certificate for domestic, Caribbean, or Central American destinations.
benefits.terms: Issued each year after Card renewal. Valid on Delta Main Cabin round-trip flights to domestic, Caribbean, or Central American destinations. Companion pays taxes and fees of approximately $22 to $250 round trip. Card Member must be on the same reservation.

benefits.name: Delta Sky Club Visits
benefits.description: 10 Delta Sky Club visits each Medallion Year when flying on an eligible Delta-marketed or Delta-operated flight.

loungeAccessDetail.guestPolicy: Up to two guests or immediate family at $50 per person per visit.

benefits.terms: 10 Visits each Medallion Year (February 1 through January 31). Requires a same-day Delta-operated or Delta-marketed WestJet flight; not available when traveling on Delta Main Basic (Basic Economy) fares. Spending $75,000 in eligible purchases in a calendar year unlocks unlimited access for the remainder of that year and the following year.

benefits.name: First Checked Bag Free
benefits.description: First checked bag free on Delta-operated flights, domestic and international.
benefits.terms: Card must be used to purchase the ticket. Available to the Card Member and up to eight travel companions on the same reservation.

benefits.name: Second Checked Bag Free
benefits.description: Second checked bag free on domestic Delta-operated flights.

benefits.name: Zone 5 Priority Boarding
benefits.description: Main Cabin 1 (Zone 5) priority boarding on Delta-operated flights.

benefits.name: TakeOff 15
benefits.description: 15% discount on the miles required when booking Delta award travel on delta.com or the Fly Delta app.
benefits.terms: Entire itinerary must be on Delta or Delta Connection carrier-operated flights, booked on delta.com or the Fly Delta app while logged into the SkyMiles account. Discount applies only to the mileage portion, not taxes and fees. Excludes Pay with Miles, Miles + Cash, and post-booking seat upgrades.

benefits.name: Delta Stays Credit
benefits.description: Annual statement credit on eligible prepaid hotel and vacation rental bookings made through Delta Stays.
benefits.terms: Up to $150 per year on eligible prepaid bookings made on the Delta Stays platform.

benefits.name: Resy Credit
benefits.description: Monthly statement credit for eligible purchases at qualifying U.S. Resy restaurants.
benefits.terms: Up to $10 back each month ($120/year total) at over 10,000 qualifying U.S. Resy restaurants. Enrollment required.

benefits.name: Rideshare Credit
benefits.description: Monthly statement credit for eligible U.S. rideshare purchases.
benefits.terms: Up to $10 per month ($120/year total). Enrollment required. Available after Card renewal. Unused monthly amounts do not roll over.

benefits.name: Global Entry or TSA PreCheck Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for a Global Entry or TSA PreCheck application fee.
benefits.terms: Up to $120 statement credit every 4 years for Global Entry, or up to $85 every 4.5 years for TSA PreCheck. Modeled here on the Global Entry cadence; verify against the chosen program's own renewal cycle.

benefits.name: MQD Headstart
benefits.description: $2,500 Medallion Qualification Dollars granted at the start of each Medallion Qualification Year toward Delta elite status.
benefits.terms: $2,500 MQDs awarded each Medallion Qualification Year. Card Members also earn MQD Boost at a rate of $1 MQD per $20 in eligible purchases.

benefits.name: Complimentary Upgrade List Access
benefits.description: Access to the complimentary upgrade list on Delta-operated flights, ranked after Medallion members and Reserve Card Members.

benefits.name: Hertz President's Circle Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Hertz Gold Plus Rewards President's Circle elite status.

benefits.name: 20% Back on In-Flight Purchases
benefits.description: 20% savings, in the form of a statement credit, on eligible in-flight purchases on Delta-operated flights.

earningRates.terms: Eligible hotel purchases made directly with the hotel.
Restaurants worldwide, including takeout and delivery in the U.S.
